P2-GAP-001.current_behavior: Employee model exists in api/app/Models/Employee.php but migration was not executed into physical database schema, leaving payroll lifecycle completely unpersisted.
P2-GAP-001.expected_principle: Every defined Eloquent model must have an authoritative physical table and formal lifecycle state machine.
P2-GAP-001.business_impact: Staff payroll attributes (salary, cycle, next payment date) cannot be stored or automated.
P2-GAP-001.data_integrity_impact: Orphan model without backing database table.
P2-GAP-001.financial_impact: Payroll expenses cannot be automatically posted to financial accounts.

P2-GAP-002.current_behavior: Tenant registration creates default Cash account with 0 balance directly without posting an initial account movement ledger row.
P2-GAP-002.expected_principle: All financial account balance initializations must have an originating ledger entry.
P2-GAP-002.business_impact: Minor; starting account begins at 0 without audit trail entry.
P2-GAP-002.data_integrity_impact: Account movement ledger begins on first transaction rather than creation.
P2-GAP-002.financial_impact: None at 0 balance, but sets precedent for unledgered balance creation.

P2-GAP-003.current_behavior: Product creation creates BranchInventory records across branches with 0 stock, but wholesale_price is not utilized in pricing tiers and margins are not live-computed in all endpoints.
P2-GAP-003.expected_principle: Product pricing fields must be completely integrated with branch inventory valuation and wholesale pricing engine.
P2-GAP-003.business_impact: Wholesale discounts cannot be automatically applied in POS for wholesale customers.

P2-GAP-004.current_behavior: Manual stock adjustments allow specifying a custom unit_cost without updating the product or branch moving-average cost formula.
P2-GAP-004.expected_principle: Inventory adjustments with cost must recalculate authoritative weighted average cost.
P2-GAP-004.business_impact: COGS and asset valuation may become distorted when stock is adjusted manually at non-standard costs.
P2-GAP-004.data_integrity_impact: BranchInventory valuation drifts from actual cost base.
P2-GAP-004.financial_impact: Distorted gross profit and balance sheet inventory asset values.
P2-GAP-004.inventory_impact: Stock quantity matches, but valuation accuracy is compromised.

P2-GAP-005.current_behavior: Inter-branch stock transfer executes instantaneous debit/credit without an in-transit status and without financial clearing entries.
P2-GAP-005.expected_principle: Physical stock transfers between distant branches should support in-transit workflow and branch clearing accounts.
P2-GAP-005.business_impact: Branch manager at destination receives stock instantly before physical delivery arrives.
P2-GAP-005.data_integrity_impact: No in-transit state exists in state machine.
P2-GAP-005.financial_impact: Branch P&L and asset division lack transfer clearing account movements.
P2-GAP-005.inventory_impact: Stock is immediately available at destination.

P2-GAP-006.current_behavior: POS sale transaction stores basic payment_method but does not persist card authorization codes or gateway transaction IDs on multi-tender split payments.
P2-GAP-006.expected_principle: Split and digital payments must capture complete audit payment references for card/bank reconciliation.
P2-GAP-006.business_impact: Bank reconciliation for card payments requires manual paper receipt matching.
P2-GAP-006.data_integrity_impact: Card authorization metadata missing from database records.
P2-GAP-006.financial_impact: Dispute resolution with merchant payment processors is slowed.

P2-GAP-007.current_behavior: PUT /sales/{id} allows mutating customer_id on posted sales without transferring historical Khata receivables or regenerating ledger entries.
P2-GAP-007.expected_principle: Customer assignment on posted credit invoices must be immutable or execute formal debtor transfer transaction.
P2-GAP-007.business_impact: Modifying a sale customer creates a discrepancy where original customer Khata balance remains debited but sale invoice displays new customer.
P2-GAP-007.data_integrity_impact: AR balance divergence between customers table and sales table.

P2-GAP-008.current_behavior: Soft deleting a Sale record does not automatically trigger stock restoration or financial reversals; requires separate cancelSale call.
P2-GAP-008.expected_principle: Deleting an active sale must either be forbidden or strictly tied to formal cancellation compensating transactions.
P2-GAP-008.business_impact: Operator might soft-delete a sale thinking it reverses stock and cash, leaving orphaned movements.
P2-GAP-008.data_integrity_impact: Orphaned InventoryMovements and CashLedger entries pointing to soft-deleted sale.
P2-GAP-008.financial_impact: Revenue deleted from sales queries but cash drawer balance remains inflated.
P2-GAP-008.inventory_impact: Stock remains decremented despite invoice deletion.

P2-GAP-009.current_behavior: Creating a customer with an opening_balance sets customers.balance directly without inserting an opening KhataTransaction ledger event.
P2-GAP-009.expected_principle: All customer balance values must be fully reconstructable from the sum of their Khata transactions.
P2-GAP-009.business_impact: Customer account statement (ledger) starts with missing opening row.
P2-GAP-009.data_integrity_impact: Sum(khata_transactions) != customers.balance until opening balance is accounted for.

P2-GAP-010.current_behavior: Manual Khata entries allow inserting arbitrary debit/credit adjustments without requiring a corresponding invoice, receipt voucher, or debit note.
P2-GAP-010.expected_principle: Manual ledger adjustments should require approval or formal adjustment document vouchers.
P2-GAP-010.business_impact: Cashiers could manually alter customer balances without verifiable source documents.
P2-GAP-010.data_integrity_impact: Ledger contains untyped manual debit/credit rows.

P2-GAP-011.current_behavior: DELETE /khata/{id} physically deletes the KhataTransaction row from the database and recalculates balance.
P2-GAP-011.expected_principle: Financial and credit ledgers must be immutable; corrections must be executed via compensating reversal entries.
P2-GAP-011.business_impact: Audit history of customer transactions is erased upon deletion.
P2-GAP-011.data_integrity_impact: Destroys chronological audit sequence and gaps transaction IDs.
P2-GAP-011.financial_impact: Historical audit failure during accounting reconciliation.

P2-GAP-012.current_behavior: Creating a supplier with opening_balance sets suppliers.balance directly without generating an opening payable ledger record.
P2-GAP-012.expected_principle: All supplier balances must be reconstructable from purchases, payments, and opening balance records.
P2-GAP-012.business_impact: Supplier statement history lacks explicit opening balance entry.
P2-GAP-012.data_integrity_impact: AP balance calculation lacks base transaction record.

P2-GAP-013.current_behavior: Purchase creation updates product stock but lacks shipping / freight landed cost allocation across line items.
P2-GAP-013.expected_principle: Landed costs (freight, customs, handling) must be proportionally allocated to item unit costs.
P2-GAP-013.business_impact: True product acquisition cost is understated when shipping fees are paid separately.
P2-GAP-013.data_integrity_impact: Unit cost in purchase_items does not reflect true landed cost.
P2-GAP-013.inventory_impact: Inventory asset valuation on balance sheet is understated.

P2-GAP-014.current_behavior: Soft deleting a received purchase removes the header from queries without executing inventory stock decrements or AP liability reversals.
P2-GAP-014.expected_principle: Deleting a purchase must require prior formal cancellation or automatically execute compensating reversals.
P2-GAP-014.business_impact: Soft-deleting a purchase leaves supplier payable balance intact while deleting the invoice view.
P2-GAP-014.data_integrity_impact: Orphaned inventory movements and supplier balance divergence.
P2-GAP-014.inventory_impact: Physical stock remains in system despite purchase record removal.

P2-GAP-015.current_behavior: SupplierPaymentController has store method but no dedicated reverse endpoint, unlike CustomerPaymentController.
P2-GAP-015.expected_principle: All payment transactions (AP and AR) must feature symmetric reversal workflows.
P2-GAP-015.business_impact: Reversing an erroneous supplier payment requires manual database intervention or complex offsetting entries.
P2-GAP-015.data_integrity_impact: Asymmetry in AP vs AR state machines.
P2-GAP-015.financial_impact: Delayed correction of erroneous bank disbursements.

P2-GAP-016.current_behavior: Expense creation permits financial_account_id to be NULL or unassigned, which skips financial account balance deduction.
P2-GAP-016.expected_principle: Every disbursed operational expense must be allocated to a specific financial account or cash drawer.
P2-GAP-016.business_impact: Expenses can be recorded in P&L without deducting cash or bank balances, causing asset/expense accounting drift.
P2-GAP-016.data_integrity_impact: Nullable financial_account_id on concrete cash expenses.
P2-GAP-016.financial_impact: Cash flow statement differs from profit & loss expenses.

P2-GAP-017.current_behavior: Soft deleting an active expense leaves the associated AccountMovement row active in financial_accounts balance without reverting funds.
P2-GAP-017.expected_principle: An active expense must be formally VOIDED (via voidExpense) before deletion to ensure balance restoration.
P2-GAP-017.business_impact: Deleting an expense without voiding leaves account balance reduced while expense report drops the row.
P2-GAP-017.data_integrity_impact: Orphaned AccountMovement without active parent Expense.
P2-GAP-017.financial_impact: Permanent discrepancy between bank ledger and expense reports.

P2-GAP-018.current_behavior: Inter-account fund transfers execute instantaneous double-entry debit/credit without intermediate clearance or bank transit states.
P2-GAP-018.expected_principle: Bank-to-bank transfers should support clearance/transit lifecycle when execution is asynchronous.
P2-GAP-018.business_impact: Inter-bank transfers that take 1-2 business days appear instantly available in destination account.
P2-GAP-018.data_integrity_impact: No in-transit state exists in AccountTransfer lifecycle.
P2-GAP-018.financial_impact: Risk of spending funds from destination account before actual bank deposit clears.

P2-GAP-019.current_behavior: Settings are stored as key-value pairs without revision history or IP/subnet pairing security validation.
P2-GAP-019.expected_principle: Critical POS and sync settings should maintain revision history and strict network binding validation.
P2-GAP-019.business_impact: Accidental configuration changes (e.g. tax rates, currency) cannot be rolled back easily.
P2-GAP-019.data_integrity_impact: Overwrites previous configuration values without versioning.
P2-GAP-019.financial_impact: Tax calculation changes affect subsequent invoices immediately.
P2-GAP-019.inventory_impact: Negative stock permission toggles affect inventory safeguards immediately.

P2-GAP-020.current_behavior: Bulk sync ingest accepts client-provided timestamps without server-authoritative clock drift verification or sequence reconciliation.
P2-GAP-020.expected_principle: Offline synchronization must enforce vector clocks or strict monotonic server sequence ordering.
P2-GAP-020.business_impact: An offline POS terminal with wrong clock date could insert invoices out of chronological sequence in financial reports.
P2-GAP-020.financial_impact: Daily revenue recognition on wrong calendar days.
P2-GAP-020.inventory_impact: Stock ledger sequence may show temporary negative balances.
